     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents rebuilt from scraps. You rebuild from scrutiny."*  
     4|*Director Elias Patel VII: "We're not just fixing buildings. We're deciding what kind of society deserves to stand."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a logistics pulse: Infrastructure Assessment Report - Post-Conflict Damage and Resource Allocation Priorities. Director Elias Patel VII adjusted his spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how societies actually put themselves back together, as he looked at the notification flashing across his console in the Valles Marineris Reconstruction Authority's planning chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," he said, his voice carrying the rasp of years spent in urban planning and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this assessment."
